title: English Practice Quiz 0800
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Financial Literacy 01: Cash flow describes?
options: money moving into and out of an organisation
questions.explanation: Option D is correct: money moving into and out of an organisation.

questions.question: Financial Literacy 02: A balance sheet reports?
options: assets, liabilities and equity at a point in time
questions.explanation: Option C is correct: assets, liabilities and equity at a point in time.

questions.question: Financial Literacy 03: An operating expense is?
options: a cost incurred in day-to-day business operations
questions.explanation: Option B is correct: a cost incurred in day-to-day business operations.

questions.question: Financial Literacy 04: Gross profit is calculated as?
options: revenue minus cost of goods sold
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: revenue minus cost of goods sold.

questions.question: Financial Literacy 05: A financial forecast is?
options: an estimate of future results based on assumptions
questions.explanation: Option D is correct: an estimate of future results based on assumptions.

questions.question: Financial Literacy 06: A credit note is commonly issued to?
options: reduce or adjust an amount previously invoiced
questions.explanation: Option C is correct: reduce or adjust an amount previously invoiced.

questions.question: Financial Literacy 07: An asset is?
options: a resource controlled by an organisation with economic value
questions.explanation: Option B is correct: a resource controlled by an organisation with economic value.

questions.question: Financial Literacy 08: A liability is?
options: an obligation the organisation is required to settle
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: an obligation the organisation is required to settle.

questions.question: Financial Literacy 09: A break-even point occurs when?
questions.explanation: Option D is correct: total revenue equals total costs.

questions.question: Financial Literacy 10: Variance analysis helps?
options: understand differences between planned and actual results
questions.explanation: Option C is correct: understand differences between planned and actual results.
